text:
emma: alert: seeing sustained large spike ~1.2M req/10m targeting /api/v1/chat and /v1/generate, starting 23:15 UTC. p95/p99 latency climbing, errors 502 increasing. possible abusive traffic patterns.
sam_infra: confirmed. concentrated from ~3 /16 prefixes, user-agent mostly `curl/7.*` and weirdbot signatures. ASN skew to one provider.
rafael_sre: digging into edge logs now. applying immediate per-route throttles and connection limits at the edge to reduce fanout. running: `edgectl rate-limit set --route "/api/v1/chat" --policy "ip:100rps,burst:200"`
maya_security: good. recommend short-lived WAF challenge rule + block known bad UA patterns. suggest ModSecurity-like rule:
```
SecRule REQUEST_HEADERS:User-Agent "curl|wget|python-requests" 
    "id:900100,phase:1,deny,log,msg:'Known abusive UA',chain"
SecRule REQUEST_URI "^/api/v1/chat"
```
apply as temporary, 15m then reassess. also enable JS challenge for browser-like flows.
deploy-bot: waf rule 900100 staged -> deploying to edge POPs (rollout 30s per POP). status: started. :rocket:
support-lead: preparing proactive customer note for affected customers on Dedicated + Hosted API. Draft: "We observed elevated request volume affecting latency for some API requests. We implemented rate limits and WAF rules to mitigate. If you see errors, please retry; reach out if persistent." will post after mitigation confirmed.
sam_infra: also added ipset block for the top 250 offending IPs and raised per-connection accept limits to prevent head-of-line drops. command used: `ipset create ddos_block hash:ip` + `ipset add ddos_block 198.51.100.23` etc.
rafael_sre: deployed route-level rate-limit and connection limiting at the proxy, p95 latency starting to normalize. errors dropping.
maya_security: audit notes: capture full request headers for a 5-minute window to S3 with server-side-encryption (KMS). ensure the export is encrypted with customer-managed key and that RBAC prevents non-security team deletion. Action items: 1) create KMS key alias `alias/incidents/ddos-2026-03` 2) add IAM condition `kms:ViaService` and restrict to security role.
emma: can you file that IAM change? we need to ensure only security and infra-sre can modify WAF rules.
maya_security: filing a change request now. also adding an audit-log alert for any WAF rule changes (CloudTrail event filter + PagerDuty).
deploy-bot: rollout complete. waf rule 900100 active in 95% POPs, ipset blocks propagated.
rafael_sre: traffic back to baseline over last 8 minutes. p99 within normal bounds. continuing 30m observation.
support-lead: posted customer note to status page: "Elevated API request volume mitigated; normal service resumed for most customers. Follow-up: working on detailed post-incident update."
maya_security: post-incident actions: (a) add automated detection for rapid prefix-skew + UA pattern, (b) add one-click playbook to apply the WAF rule + ipset, (c) runbook update on KMS export + RBAC restrictions, (d) schedule tabletop for edge abuse scenarios.
emma: nice work team. add tickets and assign owners. tagging @oncall for retention follow-up and audit export verification. :white_check_mark:
